WITH vector_results AS (
  SELECT
    base.chunk_id,
    distance AS vector_distance,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY distance ASC, base.chunk_id) AS vector_rank
  FROM VECTOR_SEARCH(
    (SELECT chunk_id, embedding_multimodal FROM `${GCP_PROJECT_ID}.rag_arena.document_chunks_v3` WHERE tier_profile = 'multimodal' AND NOT STARTS_WITH(solicitation_id, 'upl_') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(allowed_groups) AS acl_g WHERE acl_g IN UNNEST(@caller_groups))),
    'embedding_multimodal',
    (SELECT @query_embedding AS embedding_multimodal),
    top_k => 50,
    distance_type => 'COSINE'
  )
),
lexical_scored AS (
  SELECT
    chunk_id,
    SEARCH(content, REGEXP_REPLACE(@lexical_query, r'[^a-zA-Z0-9 ]', ' ')) AS all_terms_match,
    (
      SELECT SUM(IF(STRPOS(LOWER(content), term) > 0, IF(REGEXP_CONTAINS(term, r'[0-9]'), 3, 1), 0))
      FROM UNNEST(@lexical_terms) AS term
    ) AS lexical_score
  FROM `${GCP_PROJECT_ID}.rag_arena.document_chunks_v3`
  WHERE tier_profile = 'multimodal' AND NOT STARTS_WITH(solicitation_id, 'upl_') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(allowed_groups) AS acl_g WHERE acl_g IN UNNEST(@caller_groups))
),
lexical_results AS (
  SELECT chunk_id, lexical_score, lexical_rank
  FROM (
    SELECT
      chunk_id,
      lexical_score,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY all_terms_match DESC, lexical_score DESC, chunk_id) AS lexical_rank
    FROM lexical_scored
    WHERE all_terms_match OR lexical_score > 0
  )
  WHERE lexical_rank <= 50
),
fused AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(v.chunk_id, l.chunk_id) AS chunk_id,
    v.vector_rank,
    v.vector_distance,
    l.lexical_rank,
    l.lexical_score,
    COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + v.vector_rank), 0.0) + COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + l.lexical_rank), 0.0) AS rrf_score
  FROM vector_results v
  FULL OUTER JOIN lexical_results l
    ON v.chunk_id = l.chunk_id
)
SELECT
  f.chunk_id,
  c.solicitation_id,
  c.doc_name,
  c.doc_type,
  c.element_type,
  c.section_id,
  c.amendment_number,
  c.effective_date,
  c.amends_section,
  c.page_number,
  c.bbox,
  c.content,
  c.layout_source,
  c.bbox_source,
  f.vector_rank,
  f.vector_distance,
  f.lexical_rank,
  f.lexical_score,
  f.rrf_score
FROM fused f
JOIN `${GCP_PROJECT_ID}.rag_arena.document_chunks_v3` c
  ON c.chunk_id = f.chunk_id
WHERE c.tier_profile = 'multimodal'
ORDER BY f.rrf_score DESC, f.chunk_id
LIMIT 50;

WITH doc_hops AS (
  SELECT
    amd_doc_key,
    amd_doc_name,
    amd_solicitation_id,
    base_doc_key,
    base_doc_name,
    hop_count,
    amd_number,
    amd_effective_date,
    'SUPERSEDES_DOC' AS edge_type,
    base_doc_name AS target_label
  FROM GRAPH_TABLE (
    `${GCP_PROJECT_ID}.rag_arena.procurement_graph`
    MATCH p = (amd:ContractDoc)-[e:SUPERSEDES_DOC]->{1,3}(base:ContractDoc)
    COLUMNS (
      amd.doc_key AS amd_doc_key,
      amd.doc_name AS amd_doc_name,
      amd.solicitation_id AS amd_solicitation_id,
      base.doc_key AS base_doc_key,
      base.doc_name AS base_doc_name,
      PATH_LENGTH(p) AS hop_count,
      amd.amendment_number AS amd_number,
      amd.effective_date AS amd_effective_date
    )
  )
  WHERE base_doc_key IN UNNEST(@seed_doc_keys)
),
section_hops AS (
  SELECT
    amd_doc_key,
    amd_doc_name,
    amd_solicitation_id,
    sec_key AS base_doc_key,
    sec_id AS base_doc_name,
    1 AS hop_count,
    amd_number,
    amd_effective_date,
    'AMENDS_SECTION' AS edge_type,
    sec_id AS target_label
  FROM GRAPH_TABLE (
    `${GCP_PROJECT_ID}.rag_arena.procurement_graph`
    MATCH (amd:ContractDoc)-[a:AMENDS_SECTION]->(sec:ContractSection)
    COLUMNS (
      amd.doc_key AS amd_doc_key,
      amd.doc_name AS amd_doc_name,
      amd.solicitation_id AS amd_solicitation_id,
      sec.section_key AS sec_key,
      sec.section_id AS sec_id,
      a.amendment_number AS amd_number,
      a.effective_date AS amd_effective_date
    )
  )
  WHERE sec_key IN UNNEST(@seed_section_keys)
),
discovered AS (
  SELECT
    amd_doc_key,
    amd_doc_name,
    amd_solicitation_id,
    edge_type,
    target_label,
    MIN(hop_count) AS hop_count,
    MAX(amd_number) AS graph_amendment_number,
    MAX(amd_effective_date) AS graph_effective_date
  FROM (
    SELECT * FROM doc_hops
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM section_hops
  )
  GROUP BY amd_doc_key, amd_doc_name, amd_solicitation_id, edge_type, target_label
)
SELECT
  c.chunk_id,
  c.solicitation_id,
  c.doc_name,
  c.doc_type,
  c.element_type,
  c.section_id,
  c.amendment_number,
  c.effective_date,
  c.amends_section,
  c.page_number,
  c.bbox,
  c.content,
  c.layout_source,
  c.bbox_source,
  d.edge_type,
  d.target_label,
  d.hop_count
FROM discovered d
JOIN `${GCP_PROJECT_ID}.rag_arena.document_chunks_v3` c
  ON c.solicitation_id = d.amd_solicitation_id
 AND c.doc_name = d.amd_doc_name
WHERE c.tier_profile = 'multimodal'
  AND NOT STARTS_WITH(c.solicitation_id, 'upl_')
  AND COALESCE(c.amendment_number, 0) > 0
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(allowed_groups) AS acl_g WHERE acl_g IN UNNEST(@caller_groups))
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
  PARTITION BY c.chunk_id
  ORDER BY d.hop_count ASC, d.edge_type ASC, d.target_label ASC
) = 1
ORDER BY c.amendment_number DESC, d.hop_count ASC, c.page_number ASC, c.chunk_id ASC
LIMIT 12;
